name: smwmusic-touhou-hisouten-scarlet-weather-rhapsody-drunk-once-more-drunk-as-i-like-remix-iii
title: Touhou Hisouten ~ Scarlet Weather Rhapsody - Drunk Once More ~ Drunk As I Like (Remix III)
description:
Did a third arrangement of Drunk As I Like from Touhou 10.5: Scarlet Weather Rhapsody. Why? I dunno. I just felt lazy.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End," Yoshi, P-Switch, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. C# Minor w/ Detune (Remix Pitch - Listening Only)
2. C# Minor (Remix Pitch) [turned on by default]
3. D Minor (Original Pitch)
4. C Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
5. B Minor (Custom Pitch 2)
6. A# Minor (Custom Pitch 3)
7. E Minor (Custom Pitch 4)

There's also another text file that includes the sample group that you put into "Addmusic_sample groups.txt."
